rules.text: Loans more than 90 days past due move to non-performing.
Collateral is re-appraised at least every 12 months.
A purchase needs a complete loan tape for every asset.
No single borrower exceeds 2% of the book.

covenants.text: Debt service coverage ratio stays above 1.20
Audited accounts delivered within 120 days of year end
No further secured borrowing without consent
Insurance on collateral kept in force
